name: Maverick Boost - Rescue
desc: Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster from your Deck. If this card is destroyed or banished by card effect: You can add 1 "Maverick Analyzer" or "Maverick Boost" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 effect of "Maverick Boost - Rescue" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon 1 Maverick Hunter from Deck
Add 1 Maverick Analyzer or Boost card to hand
